flow_control.title: Concurrency and request rate
flow_control.description: Applies to model execution in this Core process only. Disabled preserves legacy behavior. All matching rules apply together. Key means the caller API key; account means the upstream credential.
flow_control.unsupported: This Core does not support local flow control. Existing settings are preserved.
flow_control.error: Unable to read status. Check the connection and retry.
flow_control.home_unsupported: Local flow control cannot be edited in this runtime. Home retains its own credential concurrency control.
flow_control.runtime_error: The requested configuration could not be applied. New controlled calls are stopped until the rules or state limits are corrected.
flow_control.queue_hint: Waiting does not occupy slots in that stage. Queue count, per-key count, payload bytes and wait time are bounded. This is not a process memory cap: request bodies are read before queue admission.
flow_control.rules_hint: Rules intersect; specific rules do not override broader rules. Key-model with all keys/models creates a separate bucket for every pair. Models match exactly or with one trailing *. Windows use ms: 60000 is one minute, 3600000 one hour. Model and provider matching is case-insensitive.
flow_control.invalid_number: Use a non-negative integer within the supported range.
flow_control.invalid_queue: Queue settings are incomplete or per-key capacity exceeds total capacity.
flow_control.invalid_rules: Cannot edit this rule format. Inspect the original YAML; unknown settings are preserved.
flow_control.invalid_id: Use a unique rule ID up to 64 characters: letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
flow_control.invalid_scope: Stage, scope and upstream selectors do not agree.
flow_control.invalid_reference: Use Core-provided key/account references, not plaintext credentials.
flow_control.invalid_model: Use an exact model name or one trailing *.
flow_control.invalid_windows: Use up to 8 unique positive windows; request count cannot exceed history capacity.
flow_control.empty_limit: Each rule needs a concurrency cap and/or rate window.
flow_control.rule_id: Rule ID (stable IDs preserve rate history)
flow_control.request_hint: A Manager operation includes its internal retries and account waiting. Handler-level re-entry is a new operation. The first output chunk does not release the slot.
flow_control.attempt_hint: Attempt slots count Manager retries and parallel branches. Idle WebSockets do not count as inference. Transport retries inside one executor invocation remain one attempt.
flow_control.runtime_hint: Latest read from Core, not unsaved form values. Counts are process-local; first enable does not retroactively count already-running work.
flow_control.first_rows: Showing at most 30 buckets. Management API returns up to 1000.
flow_control.continuity_hint: With local flow control, wait for execution capacity before reserving Codex continuity state. Queued work is not an upstream incumbent.
flow_control.selected_user: Caller key used to access CPA
flow_control.special_placeholder: Select the actual ID of the model called “Taylor”
flow_control.model_placeholder: Choose a model, or an explicit trailing-* prefix
flow_control.model_scope_warning: Requested names may be aliases. Execution rules use resolved names. The GPT-6 rule shares one total over its matching range. Do not guess an upstream ID from a nickname.
flow_control.inspector_desc: Inspect matching draft rules, then ask Core about its live policy. This does not reserve capacity or call a model.
flow_control.draft_diff: The draft differs from Core. Draft explanations are not the active configuration.
flow_control.draft_disabled: The draft is disabled. These rules are previews until saved and enabled.
flow_control.model_probe: Concrete model for this request (no wildcard)
flow_control.exact_model_placeholder: The exact model ID used in your deployment
flow_control.select_credential: Choose an auth file or upstream API-key entry
flow_control.credential_filter: Upstream credential filter (one auth file / API-key entry)
flow_control.no_matching_rules: No rule matches this identity. These rules do not constrain it.
flow_control.draft_usage_note: “?” means usage cannot be inferred for a new or regrouped draft, not zero usage. Use Core for rate-window decisions.
flow_control.explain_error: Could not retrieve the explanation. Check the connection and retry.
flow_control.advisory: This is advisory and reserves nothing. Queued requests and concurrent arrivals can change the result.
flow_control.upstream_apikey: API key used to access AI
flow_control.live_desc: Observe active and waiting work without request bodies. Live mode receives one snapshot per second and pauses when the page is hidden.
flow_control.until_complete: Held until the producer ends this turn
flow_control.wait_not_ttl: Queue deadline, not an execution TTL
flow_control.trend_label: Recent samples: solid = executing; dashed = waiting
flow_control.search_placeholder: Key label, model, account or request ID
flow_control.no_activity: No activity matches the current filters.
flow_control.disabled_activity: Flow control is disabled; work started while disabled is not counted retroactively.
flow_control.activity_truncated: {{count}} total entries; at most 200 returned. Filters apply to returned rows only. Totals are not truncated.
flow_control.activity_note: A request has separate request-stage and execution-stage records sharing a request ID; do not add both totals. Canceled producers retain slots while ending. Queue position is not a promised execution order.
flow_control.live_incomplete: Incomplete identity: execution eligibility is unknown
flow_control.v3_description: Combine caller, model and upstream account limits. Selection chooses traffic; grouping chooses shared or separate counters. Every matching rule applies.
flow_control.v3_observation_hint: Observation is independent of admission. Turning it off does not cancel work or release slots. No polling fallback. Resource reads are on demand and do not store history.
flow_control.v3_resources: Collect process and disk metrics on demand
flow_control.v3_migration_hint: Legacy behavior is retained. V3 uses one auth record per account and joint first admission: initial waiters are not started calls. Preview first, then let existing work drain before saving a version change.
flow_control.v3_migration_error: Could not load migration. Existing rules are unchanged.
flow_control.v3_migration_ready: References can be converted unambiguously. Applying only fills the draft; it does not enable or save the policy.
flow_control.v3_migration_ack: I understand the initial-wait counting and account-reference changes
flow_control.v3_wait_hint: Initial waiting holds neither call nor attempt slots. Retries share a cumulative wait budget. Extra parallel attempts never queue. A zero queue size or timeout rejects immediately. Queued bytes are not a process-memory cap.
flow_control.v3_rule_hint: Selections are OR within a field and AND across fields. Without model grouping selected models share a cap; with it they count separately. Overlapping sets consume every matching rule. No rule overrides another.
flow_control.v3_group_hint: Dimensions marked shared are combined. With all shared, every matching request uses one total cap.
flow_control.v3_windows_hint: Concurrency counts in-flight work. Rate windows separately count admissions. Leave them empty for concurrency-only queueing.
flow_control.v3_custom_model: Exact model or explicit trailing *; provider::model supported
flow_control.v3_preview_hint: Core evaluates up to 24 exact models with the admission matcher. Missing identity or changed draft counting scope is unknown, not zero.
flow_control.v3_preview_bound: Compare at most 24 models; preview targets cannot be prefixes.
flow_control.v3_stale_preview: Inputs or draft changed. Evaluate again.
flow_control.v3_matrix_hint: — means no match; ? means unknown usage. Select a model to inspect every matching rule. Do not sum rule counters as a request total.
flow_control.v3_preview_advisory: Read-only point-in-time explanation: no reservations or start-time prediction. First admission must satisfy both call and attempt stages. Disabled drafts do not enforce limits.
flow_control.v3_live_desc: Shared lightweight summary without per-request explanations; manual by default.
flow_control.v3_realtime_off: Live updates are disabled or unsupported by Core. Manual refresh remains available; no automatic polling.
flow_control.v3_resource_note: Process metrics are not flow-control-only memory, RSS or container usage. Heap reads are cached for 5 s and free-space reads for 30 s. No directory scans or history writes.
flow_control.v3_detail_hint: Details are generated only for the requested page, never with live summaries. State may change between pages; positions do not promise execution order.
flow_control.v3_required: A V3-capable Core is required; collection fields must not be silently sent to older Core.
flow_control.invalid_observation: Observation interval must be 500–30000 ms and observers 1–16.
flow_control.invalid_selection: Select 1–256 items or explicitly choose All. Empty selections never mean All.
flow_control.selection_conflict: Legacy scalar and collection conflict; complete migration.
flow_control.migrate_required: V3 has one upstream account object; migrate legacy credential fields.
flow_control.counts_hint: Logical calls and upstream attempts are different counts; do not add them together. First-time waiting calls have not started.
flow_control.phase_draining: Canceled; waiting for producer to end

validation.flow_control_config: Cannot edit this rule format. Inspect the original YAML; unknown settings are preserved.
